Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing additional investment authority for specified hospital districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the exemption of public hospital districts fromregulatory restrictions on investments; and adding a new section tochapter 70.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In addition to any other investment authority granted by law,public hospital districts with annual revenues exceeding one hundredmillion dollars, of which less than five percent is derived fromregular property taxes as defined in RCW 84.04.140, are authorized toinvest their funds and money in their custody or possession, eligiblefor investment, in appropriate investment vehicles, as reasonably andprudently determined by the finance or investment committees of suchdistricts.
